stories.title: Rocky and the Pebble Worth Keeping
stories.outro: See you next time in Sunny Meadow!
stories.moral: Something can be precious because of what it means to you.
moralRhyme: Big or little, gray or blue,
Keep what holds some joy for you!

youtube.title: Rocky and the Pebble Worth Keeping | Sunny Meadow
youtube.description: Rocky's favorite pebble looked dull beside Harry's shiny shell. He hid the gray stone behind his tail. A gentle friendship story. Something can be precious because of what it means to you. #SunnyMeadow #DreamyDiscoveries

lines.text: Rocky's favorite pebble looked dull beside Harry's shiny shell.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He hid the gray stone behind his tail.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: My collection does not have anything that sparkles.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I brought this shell to show you its shiny middle.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Rocky had planned a small show-and-tell on the bench.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He wanted to share yesterday's happy beach walk.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: This pebble seemed very special when I found it.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: What made you choose that particular one?
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Rocky rubbed the stone against his soft little sleeve.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Its gray surface stayed exactly the same dull color.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Perhaps I can make it shine like your shell.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Some stones stay gray even after a good polish.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Rocky stood it on a tall folded-paper stand.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The tiny pebble almost vanished behind its fancy label.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Now my collection has a very grand display.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Your label seems to be showing itself off.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Must Rocky trade his favorite pebble?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Harry offered a spare shiny shell for a trade.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rocky looked between the shell and his gray pebble.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I thought I wanted the shiniest thing here.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: We do not have to trade unless you want to.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Rocky put the pebble in the middle of his palm.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Its small shape fitted comfortably against his fingers.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I found it when we stopped watching the waves.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Beside the little curved path down to the sand?
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Rocky remembered Harry making three slow hoofprints nearby.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: They had laughed at a wave washing the last one.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I kept it because our walk felt so happy.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I remember that walk. My last hoofprint became the sea.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Rocky held his pebble beside the glittering little shell.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: For the first time, he did not try comparing them.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Your shell is shiny. My pebble remembers our walk.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Then they have two very different stories to tell.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Rocky told Harry he wanted to keep the gray pebble.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Harry put his spare shell back beside the first.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Thank you for offering. I will keep this one.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Of course. It belongs in the collection you enjoy.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Why is the pebble special to Rocky?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rocky folded his paper stand into a smaller little tray.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He set the pebble where it was easy to see.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: This display leaves room for the pebble itself.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: And room for its owner to tell the important part.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Rocky described their beach walk before showing the stone.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Harry listened to the story behind its dull gray color.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: This is the pebble from our happy wave-watching day.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Now I know why you chose that particular one.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Harry showed the shell that reminded him of the water.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Neither friend asked whose collection was worth more.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Your shell carries a piece of that walk too.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Yes. We brought two different reminders home together.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Rocky tucked his pebble into a safe little pocket.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The folded tray stayed beside Harry's shiny shells.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I will take it out when I miss the waves.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Perhaps next time we can visit the beach again.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Harry looked at the gray pebble in Rocky's pocket.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rocky gave it a very important introduction.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Small stone. Extremely large happy memory.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: It must be a very roomy pebble inside.
lines.speaker: friend
